summary: 27-year-old man whose brother is IVCT-confirmed MH-susceptible, untested himself, listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative assessment for planned gallbladder operation
inputs.hpi: Symptomatic gallstones, listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. His brother developed malignant hyperthermia during an appendicectomy in 2022 and was confirmed MH-susceptible on muscle biopsy (IVCT). The patient has not been tested. Never had a general anaesthetic. Fit and well otherwise.

exam.general: Well. HR 66, BP 124/76, RR 12, SpO2 99% on air, T 36.6°C.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Multiple mobile gallstones, gallbladder wall 2 mm, no pericholecystic fluid. CBD 4 mm. Liver normal.

comorbidities: Family history of malignant hyperthermia (brother IVCT-confirmed MH-susceptible); patient untested

confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic cholelithiasis. Brother IVCT-confirmed malignant hyperthermia susceptible; patient untested — treat as MH-susceptible.

guideline.name: Association of Anaesthetists guideline — malignant hyperthermia 2020
guideline.section: MH-susceptible patients and untested first-degree relatives of an MH-susceptible patient: trigger-free anaesthesia (no volatile agents, no suxamethonium), dantrolene immediately available, refer relatives to an MH unit for testing
guideline.citation: Hopkins PM, Girard T, Dalay S, et al. Malignant hyperthermia 2020: Guideline from the Association of Anaesthetists. Anaesthesia. 2021;76:655–64.

rationale: Permutation: anaesthetic-specific hazard recorded in the history. Tests an MH alert, trigger-free anaesthesia, dantrolene availability and referral of the untested relative.
